# SPC Labs — SPC Capital Inc.

> SPC Capital Inc. (SPC Labs) is a Calgary, Alberta based proprietary systematic momentum trading firm. Process over prediction: disciplined, statistically driven algorithmic strategies across equities and crypto.

## About

- Company: SPC Capital Inc. (operating as SPC Labs)
- Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- Founder: Hågen Sagli (also written Haagen Sagli / Hagen Sagli)
- Approach: Systematic, quantitative, disciplined — process over prediction
- Strategies: Proprietary momentum-based algorithmic trading (equities and crypto)

## Note

Strategy methodology, signals, and research are proprietary and not publicly disclosed.
